summary: Batch fresh work-owner and pinned mission-definition reads in reconciliation

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger, claim kind or storage version change. The indexed person-ask origin probe requires the existing index that normal Store schema installation creates before readers are available.

rules.detail: Effective run/generation/root state, lease expiry, person blockers, queue and timeout fields, handoff and responses retain their existing rules. Runtime/effect authority guards and launch dispatch are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: All current-generation work including terminal steps remains eligible for the same ordered view and wake closure. No-release/no-person-request proofs from the same snapshot skip only empty handoff/response reads; any presence retains the original reader. Owner reads deduplicate exact run/generation pairs within the invocation and use groups of at most 128 supplied contexts; pinned definitions are read once per distinct generation and parsed once per invocation after releasing the read snapshot. One clock per call is retained. Missing owner/definition rows remain optional as before and malformed definitions refuse the whole result. Multiple simultaneous storage errors can change diagnostic precedence or column numbers; no partial vector is returned. Each call reads fresh database inputs, with no retained context or authority reuse. The old call used one clock on a reader connection without a dedicated transaction; the new call pins one coherent cut. Concurrent mixed-cut results are not promised identical: commits during the call appear on the next read, and fresh effect guards remain authoritative. Definition field lookups use a single display-order depth-first path index per generation, retaining the first matching path; a missing display-order reference reached by a lookup now refuses the whole result rather than panicking.

downtime.detail: Removes empty per-step handoff/response queries, repeated per-step owner queries and repeated pinned-definition queries, JSON parsing and repeated mission-tree walks from work reconciliation. Synthetic parity, boundary, indexed-plan and whole-read SQL/VM controls are included; production SQL-per-minute, phase share, CPU, latency and snapshot duration remain unmeasured until qualification and the single capture after deployment.

manual.detail: No new manual steps or configuration.

recovery.detail: The reader writes no state. Source rollback restores the previous per-step reader without a migration.
